plain: Hard to manage, control or solve

webster.text: Not to be governed or managed; violent; stubborn; obstinate; refractory; as an intractable temper.

example.quote: Antipathy in one nation against another disposes each more readily to offer insult and injury, to lay hold of slight causes of umbrage, and to be haughty and intractable, when accidental or trifling occasions of dispute occur.
